review_scope: Primary read the complete first-pass report, its cited evidence, and independently read the complete generator, browser JavaScript and controls.json. Remaining required source files were read completely by the first-pass reviewer; this is not an independent double annotation of every source file.
decision: Keep 3D, temporal No, reasoning/planning Yes and exploration/interface Yes at the baseline. Support crates change the elevations usable on the later cargo traversal; the task is not merely an isometric depiction of a planar route. Discrete moves, climbs and cargo actions leave the relevant state visible. Orbit provides active inspection of overlapping near/far cells and stacks.

rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: Do not treat omitted construction-only route data or the grader's camera quota as proof of exploration. The relevant evidence is the spatial inspection provided by changing the view of depth-staggered cells and stacked crates. The displayed STEP/DECOY labels mean that hidden crate identity or unknown interface rules are not the reason for this label.
rationale_clarifications.temporal: The full camera drag changes yaw by pointer displacement and can be completed without interpreting motion or managing duration, consistently with the corrected Facet Lantern temporal label.

uncertainties: Source-only spatial inspection judgment. No runtime test establishes camera necessity for every seed or low-difficulty profile; the no-exception result means no additional source-supported exception was established, not an empirical proof that every seed requires orbit.
